InvestmentAsset.title: InvestmentAsset
InvestmentAsset.description: A capitalised asset eligible for one or more investeringsaftrek schemes (KIA/EIA/MIA/Vamil) per Wet IB 2001 art. 3.40-3.47. 1-to-1 with FixedAsset (fixedAssetId). Eligibility is classified at capitalisation against the four schemes (REQ-INV-001); the RvO meldingstermijn deadline is derived from opdrachtverleningDatum (REQ-INV-007). Introduced by the bookkeeping-investeringsaftrek change (T4).

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this asset for tenant isolation.

fixedAssetId.description: 1-to-1 FK to the FixedAsset this InvestmentAsset overlays (bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation).

factuurnummer.description: Supplier invoice number for audit linkage.

aanschafdatum.description: Invoice/acquisition date. NOT used for the RvO deadline (see opdrachtverleningDatum).

opdrachtverleningDatum.description: Date the binding order was placed. Mandatory for EIA/MIA/Vamil assets; the RvO 3-month meldingstermijn runs from this date, NOT the invoice or delivery date (REQ-INV-007).

ingebruiknameDatum.description: Date the asset was taken into use; relevant for Vamil 75%-direct timing.

aanschafwaarde.description: Acquisition value in minor currency units (EUR cents), excluding recoverable BTW.

valuta.description: ISO 4217 currency code. EUR-only in this tier.

btwRegime.description: BTW handling for the asset (aftrekbaar/niet-aftrekbaar/gemengd); affects the aftrek grondslag.

categorie.description: Free-text or taxonomy category used for code lookup hints.

energielijstCode.description: Matched EnergielijstCode.code (EIA). Resolved against the opdrachtverleningDatum year list (REQ-INV-002).

milieulijstCode.description: Matched MilieulijstCode.code (MIA/Vamil). Resolved against the opdrachtverleningDatum year list (REQ-INV-002).

kiaEligible.description: Whether the asset qualifies for KIA (computed by the eligibility classifier; operator-overridable).

eiaEligible.description: Whether the asset qualifies for EIA (Energielijst match + EUR 2.5k minimum).

miaEligible.description: Whether the asset qualifies for MIA (Milieulijst match + EUR 2.5k minimum).

vamilEligible.description: Whether the asset qualifies for Vamil (Milieulijst + vamilToegestaan + EUR 2.5k minimum).

eligibilityOverride.description: Boekhouder override of the computed classification, per scheme, with a mandatory rationale (REQ-INV-001 / D2).

rationale.example: Niet claimen: asset is geleased, niet in eigendom.

rvoMeldingDatum.description: Date the RvO melding was submitted.

rvoMeldingDeadline.description: Computed deadline = opdrachtverleningDatum + 3 months (REQ-INV-007). Derived by DesinvesteringsbijtellingGuard::computeMeldingDeadline / the calculations engine.

rvoReferentie.description: RvO eLoket reference once a melding is submitted.

EnergielijstCode.title: EnergielijstCode
EnergielijstCode.description: Reference data: a single RvO Energielijst code (EIA) for a given jaartal. Versioned per year; codes are resolved against the opdrachtverleningDatum year, not the current year (REQ-INV-002). Seeded from lib/Settings/seeds/investeringsaftrek-energielijst-2026.json.

jaartal.description: List year this code belongs to.

deelpercentage.description: Percentage of the investment that qualifies (often 100).

maxBedragPerEenheid.description: Maximum qualifying amount per unit in EUR cents, when capped.

MilieulijstCode.title: MilieulijstCode
MilieulijstCode.description: Reference data: a single RvO Milieulijst code (MIA/Vamil) for a given jaartal. Carries the MIA percentage (27/36/45) and the vamilToegestaan flag. Versioned per year. Seeded from lib/Settings/seeds/investeringsaftrek-milieulijst-2026.json.

vamilToegestaan.description: Whether Vamil willekeurige afschrijving is permitted for this code.

maxBedrag.description: Maximum qualifying amount in EUR cents, when capped.

InvesteringsaftrekClaim.title: InvesteringsaftrekClaim
InvesteringsaftrekClaim.description: One claim per (asset, scheme, boekjaar) combination. Carries the grondslag, percentage and computed aftrekbedrag, plus the ingediend -> definitief lifecycle and the async RvO beschikking. Vrijwillige verlaging is tracked separately from the legal entitlement (REQ-INV-009). Introduced by bookkeeping-investeringsaftrek.

boekjaar.description: Fiscal year the claim applies to.

grondslag.description: Base amount the percentage applies to, in EUR cents.

percentage.description: Applied percentage (e.g. 40 for EIA, 27/36/45 for MIA). Null for KIA (tiered).

aftrekbedrag.description: Computed deduction in EUR cents (after any vrijwillige verlaging).

rvoBeschikking.description: RvO award, populated async via the openconnector mededeling feed or overridden by the boekhouder (REQ-INV-007 / D8).

vrijwilligeVerlaging.description: Voluntary reduction applied to the legal entitlement, in EUR cents (REQ-INV-009). Not carry-forwardable.

verlaginRationale.description: Mandatory rationale when a vrijwillige verlaging is applied.

VamilDepreciation.title: VamilDepreciation
VamilDepreciation.description: Willekeurige afschrijving schedule for a Vamil-claimed asset: 75% direct in the year of ingebruikname + 25% via the regular depreciation schedule. Consumed by bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation via the InvestmentAsset relation (REQ-INV-010 / D6).

gespreidDeel.description: Remaining 25% spread over the regular schedule, in EUR cents.

regulierAfschrijfschema.description: The regular schedule for the 25% gespreid deel.

KIATier.title: KIATier
KIATier.description: Reference data: the 2026 KIA tiered lookup table (Wet IB 2001 art. 3.41, geindexeerd). KIA is aggregated at boekjaar level over the running kiaJaartotaal; the tier is resolved by KiaSchalenLookup (ADR-031 exception guard). Seeded from lib/Settings/seeds/investeringsaftrek-kia-tiers-2026.json.

vanaf.description: Lower bound of the tier (inclusive), EUR cents.

tot.description: Upper bound of the tier (exclusive), EUR cents. Null for the open top tier.

percentage.description: Percentage applied within the tier (28 for tier 2; -7.56 for the tier-4 taper). Null for the flat-amount tier 3.

vastBedrag.description: Flat KIA amount for the tier in EUR cents (tier 3/4 anchor). Null where the tier is purely percentage.

regel.description: Human-readable description of the tier rule.
